mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate olanzapine's metabolic effects and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension and arrhythmias; olanzapine may cause weight gain and metabolic dysfunction which compounds diuretic therapy complications.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, assess blood pressure changes, and consider potassium-sparing diuretic alternatives or potassium supplementation if used together.
